'''Reflections Booster Draft''' is a booster draft format in the [[Players Committee]]'s ''Alternate Format Tournament Guide'' (revised September 2015), played with [[Reflections]], [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy|Reflections II]] or [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III]] boosters. The guide's list of sealed formats names it as '''Reflections II Booster Draft''' and '''Reflections III Booster Draft'''.<ref name="afg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Star Wars CCG Alternate Format Tournament Guide] (revised 09/2015), Players Committee. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195355/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Type:''' booster draft
* '''Defined by:''' Players Committee (Alternate Format Tournament Guide, 2015); Decipher had a Reflections II booster draft format by 2002
* '''Card pool:''' 4 Reflections, Reflections II or Reflections III boosters per player, plus up to six battleground locations brought by the player
* '''In use:''' by 2002 (Reflections II) &ndash; listed in 2015
* '''Also called:''' Reflections II Booster Draft; Reflections III Booster Draft
* '''GEMP:''' none (GEMP's [[Reflections Sealed]] is a separate sealed league)

== Card pool ==
Each player needs four Reflections, Reflections II or Reflections III booster packs. The format uses the guide's [[Booster Draft]] rules.<ref name="afg" />

Each player may also bring six battleground locations to include in their deck. The Tournament Director checks that these locations are battlegrounds before the tournament starts.<ref name="afg" /> The guide does not give a deck size for this format; deck building time is 10 minutes for 40-card decks and 20 minutes for 60-card decks.<ref name="afg" />

== History ==
In August 2002 [[Decipher]]'s Star Wars tournament resources page linked a "Reflections II Booster Draft Format" among its format notes.<ref name="dec-ressw">[http://tournaments.decipher.com/resources-sw.asp Star Wars tournament resources], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020808154840/http://tournaments.decipher.com/resources-sw.asp Internet Archive].</ref> Every Internet Archive capture of that linked page (reflections2.asp, 2002&ndash;2003) is an error page, so Decipher's rules for it are unknown. No event in this format is recorded on this wiki.
